blocks.text: ARA manages the research process: questions, current claims, concepts, experiment design, evidence inventory, and append-only exploration history. Proofpress records independently verifiable versions of accepted research artifacts. They overlap at a meaningful accepted revision, but they do not duplicate ownership.

| ARA owns | Proofpress adds |
|---|---|
| C/N/E identifiers, claim-to-evidence relationships, and research DAG | independently verifiable versions of a concrete artifact |
| session before/after logic records | actor, reason, declaration, and difference for an accepted revision |
| mutable current-state `logic/` plus append-only `trace/`, `staging/`, `evidence/` | portable, artifact-level lineage that survives outside the original repo/session |
| scientific rigor review | evidence envelope proving integrity of named files and claimed version continuity |

Proofpress does not decide whether an experiment result is scientifically valid; ARA's rigor-review process does. ARA does not replace the portable integrity and revision provenance of a Proofpress capsule.

`ara/` is the laboratory notebook and paper-management layer. It records the active sequence—STALE/CUPMem, Memory Laundering/PPMF, MAST, then ARA/APEX—alongside historical MemConflict, Harvey, and C&H records. It is never injected into a benchmark agent's context and is not an experimental condition.

At a meaningful accepted research milestone, Proofpress snapshots the affected Markdown artifact—for example this protocol, an accepted `ara/logic/*.md` revision, `PAPER.md`, or a sanitized evidence index. The snapshot claims JSON points to only the changed ARA C/E/N IDs and evidence paths. The corresponding ARA session record stores the Proofpress event/evidence ID rather than duplicating full history.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  S["Research session"] --> A["ARA: logic, trace, evidence"]
  A --> R["Accepted research revision"]
  R --> P["Proofpress portable snapshot"]
  P --> E["Evidence envelope + revision ID"]
  E --> T["ARA session record stores pointer"]
  T --> W["Paper / reproducible review package"]
```
The evidence envelope validates the completeness and identity of named files. It does not certify that a research conclusion is true. That boundary is intentional and should be stated in the paper.

The official ARA source is cloned locally at `third_party/ara-source`; the official installer added six repository-local Codex skills under `.codex/skills/`. Both are ignored to prevent a vendored external project or local agent configuration from being committed. Reinstall/verify instructions and the fixed upstream commit are in `ara/UPSTREAM.md`.
